mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 PM, here is today's balanced dish: we are looking at 74 degrees with overcast skies near Badger Prairie County Park and a third quarter moon phase, plus an overnight low of 66 degrees with rain predicted overnight.

The Verona Senior Center is promoting their tri-shaw bike program where you can enjoy free rides on the Military Ridge State Trail, and the city is also highlighting seasonal job opportunities for those interested in joining the Recreation Department team.

Today you can head to Hop Haus Brewing Company or Wisconsin Brewing Company for trivia, and tomorrow you should look out for the downtown farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park as well as more trivia options.
On July 31, an officer conducted a traffic stop that led to the arrest of a Madison woman for O W I after she was observed operating a vehicle without activated taillights.
Today's flavor of the day is Butter Pecan. The store is currently closed, but they will be ready to serve you starting at 10 AM tomorrow, when the flavor changes to Peanut Butter Fudge Brownie.
